items.name: visit
items.signature: fn visit<V: Visitor>(ast: &ast::Ast, visitor: V) -> Result<V::Output, V::Err>
items.summary: Executes an implementation of `Visitor` in constant stack space.

items.name: Visitor
items.summary: A trait for visiting an abstract syntax tree (AST) in depth first order.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: All implementors of `Visitor` must provide a `finish` method, which yields the result of visiting the AST or an error.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: This method is called before beginning traversal of the AST.

methods.name: visit_alternation_in
methods.summary: This method is called between child nodes of an [`Alternation`](ast::Alternation).

methods.name: visit_class_set_binary_op_in
methods.summary: This method is called between the left hand and right hand child nodes of a [`ClassSetBinaryOp`](ast::ClassSetBinaryOp).

methods.name: visit_class_set_binary_op_post
methods.summary: This method is called on every [`ClassSetBinaryOp`](ast::ClassSetBinaryOp) after descending into child nodes.

methods.name: visit_class_set_binary_op_pre
methods.summary: This method is called on every [`ClassSetBinaryOp`](ast::ClassSetBinaryOp) before descending into child nodes.

methods.name: visit_class_set_item_post
methods.summary: This method is called on every [`ClassSetItem`](ast::ClassSetItem) after descending into child nodes.

methods.name: visit_class_set_item_pre
methods.summary: This method is called on every [`ClassSetItem`](ast::ClassSetItem) before descending into child nodes.

methods.name: visit_concat_in
methods.summary: This method is called between child nodes of a concatenation.

methods.name: visit_post
methods.summary: This method is called on an `Ast` after descending all of its child `Ast` nodes.

methods.name: visit_pre
methods.summary: This method is called on an `Ast` before descending into child `Ast` nodes.
